name: Canadian Tech Price Index
license: Free to cite with a link to the relevant tracker or index page
methodology: Daily configuration-level minimums across qualifying public prices from Best Buy Canada, Canada Computers, Newegg Canada, and Memory Express. Amazon.ca price observations are excluded from public exports. Used, refurbished, open-box, Marketplace, invalid, and non-matching rows are excluded. Missing observations are not interpolated.

datasets.name: Canadian RAM Price History
datasets.description: Daily lowest qualifying Canadian desktop DDR4 and DDR5 kit prices by configuration.
datasets.variable_measured: Lowest observed in-stock desktop RAM kit price in Canadian dollars
datasets.missing_data_policy: Missing dates and configurations remain absent; no interpolation or carry-forward.
datasets.amazon_price_policy: Amazon.ca price observations are excluded from public downloads.
